title: Game closes when using Network Filesystem with C# on Android
body:
### Tested versions

Tested with 4.4.1.stable.mono.official, [Godot_v4.5-android-no-copy_mono](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105262)

### System information

Android 14 (Redmi Note 14). Compatibility Renderer

### Issue description

When enabling "Small Deploy with Network Filesystem" on the Debug options, the game was closing upon start.

I created a small project using only GDScript and it worked as expected. I added a C# script to load it after a while. The game opens normally but closes when it tries to load the C# script.

I've tried to get some logs with adb and it seems like the dotnet DLLs are not loaded when using remote filesystem.

### Steps to reproduce

- Enable "Small Deploy with Network Filesystem"
- Run the game via Remote Deploy
- Load a C# script
